# ArtiQ Smart AR Physiotherapy

> Real-time augmented reality hand grip rehabilitation and MyoWare 2.0 wireless EMG clinical telemetry platform.

## Overview
ArtiQ combines client-side MediaPipe Hands computer vision with ESP32 MyoWare 2.0 surface electromyography (EMG) biofeedback over MQTT to guide physiotherapy grip exercises and log clinical repetition sessions.

## Public Routes
- `/`: Clinical authentication wall and desktop webcam AR rehabilitation dashboard (requires desktop viewport >= 900px).
- `/privacy.html`: Privacy policy covering administrator OTP verification, local Edge AI webcam processing, and EMG session data.

## API Health
- `/api/v1/health`: Service and PostgreSQL database health check endpoint.
